blocks.text: Surrey Condos Under $800K — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of condos sell under $800,000 in Surrey, BC?
The sub-$800,000 bracket covers the vast majority of apartment listings across Surrey, including concrete high-rise studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom units in
Whalley / Surrey City Centre
and
Guildford
, as well as 4- to 6-storey wood-frame 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments in Fleetwood, Newton,
Cloverdale
, and South Surrey.
What is the difference between concrete high-rise and wood-frame condos in Surrey?

Concrete high-rises (concentrated around Gateway, Surrey Central, and King George SkyTrain stations) offer concrete slab acoustic separation, high-speed elevators, and central HVAC systems, whereas 4- to 6-storey wood-frame buildings in Fleetwood, Cloverdale, and South Surrey typically offer larger floorplates per dollar and lower monthly strata fees.
Which Surrey neighbourhoods have direct SkyTrain access for condo buyers?

Today's Expo Line serves Scott Road, Gateway, Surrey Central, and King George stations in North Surrey. The 16-kilometre Surrey-Langley SkyTrain extension along Fraser Highway adds 8 new stations at 140 Street, 152 Street, 160 Street, 166 Street, 184 Street, 190 Street, 196 Street, and 203 Street.
What are typical monthly strata fees for Surrey condos under $800K?

Monthly strata fees generally range from $270 to $460 in wood-frame buildings and $380 to $620 in concrete towers with concierge, gym, or central heating/cooling systems. Always inspect the Form B Information Certificate and Depreciation Report.
Are rentals and pets allowed in Surrey condo buildings?

Provincial Strata Property Act rules eliminate standard residential rental restrictions across BC (while still allowing strata corporations to ban short-term Airbnb-style rentals). Pet restrictions remain set by each strata corporation's bylaws, commonly allowing 1 or 2 dogs or cats.
Does GST apply to condos under $800K in Surrey?

Resale condos that have been lived in are generally exempt from 5% GST, whereas brand-new presale completions or substantially renovated assignments are subject to 5% GST (with partial federal/provincial new-housing rebates available below statutory price thresholds).
How do Surrey condos under $800K compare with Surrey townhomes under $1.2M?
Condos under $800K provide single-level living with underground stall parking, while
Surrey townhomes under $1.2M
deliver multi-level 2- to 4-bedroom floorplans with private garages and ground-floor patio or yard access.
